sc: Acadia logs are logs cut from the acadia trees found in the Kharidian Desert.
It is also the only core log, that cannot be obtained via the the Polishing perk.

Adamant armour set + 1 (lg).x: Adamant armour set + 1 (lg) is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: Only prismatic skill cards could be won from 29 August until 9 September 2014, but previously won cards could be completed until 9 October.

q: Anger Battleaxe, Maul, Spear and Sword overrides
sc: It is unlocked by completing A Soul's Bane quest.
It is found in the Rage room's weapon rack.
Only one anger weapon is obtainable at a time.
It is made from 5 apex leather, 5 apex sinew, 1 steel studs, and 1 steel bar via the tailoring process, requiring level 100 Crafting.
The Artefact locations list is given to the player once they have done a job in each category assigned by the God emissaries.
The tier 70 augmented Deathwarden robe bottom is created by using an augmentor on a tier 70 deathwarden robe bottom.
It is made by dyeing a pair of augmented elite sirenic chaps with a Third Age dye.
It may also be made by augmenting a pair of elite sirenic chaps (Third Age) at an inventor's workbench.
An augmented lava whip is a level 85 melee main hand weapon created by using an augmentor on a lava whip.
It can be made by taking a Pirate bandana (white) and an left eyepatch to Patchy on Mos Le'Harmless and paying him 500 coins to sew them together.

Barbarian assault ticket - wave 9.x: The Barbarian assault ticket - wave 9 is an item that is obtained from Captain Cain or Commander Connad by requesting to change your current wave in Barbarian Assault from wave nine back to wave one, or attempting to enter the wave one lobby.

sc: They require 85 Magic, Strength, and Defence to wear, but not to obtain.
They may be received after winning a game of Pest Control - an interface will appear from which one of the three hybrid armour boots can be chosen.
Black navy slacks is a cosmetic item that can be purchased from Honest Jimmy for 100 pieces of eight.
It can be found in the mound of soil, a few paces north-east of the wheat field in Mos Le'Harmless.
Blowpipe fins are a rare drop from the certain dinosaur Slayer monsters of Anachronia.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 bronze bars, requiring 200 progress to complete, granting a total of 30 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like medium plated bronze salvage by the spring cleaner.

h: Via skilling, killing Clawdia, and the New Item Shop
sc: A Bronzed Sun Hat token is an item that was first made available from the 2021 Beach event.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Bronzed Sun Hat cosmetic override, destroying the token permanently after a confirmation.
The Brutal Mace (called the Brutal Club in the store) is a cosmetic override available from Solomon's General Store.

Butterfly token.x: Butterfly tokens are a promotional Treasure Hunter prize that will prestige the current set of nodes on the butterfly.

sc: Celebration candles are sold by Diango.
Clue scroll (easy) is a simple clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.
Clue scroll (master) is an emote clue obtained from master sealed clue scrolls.
It can be obtained by players who previously completed the quest before 26 November 2013 from Xenia.

s: Burthorpe; can be accessed via Dark Phoenix Sigil
Burthorpe; can be accessed via Showdown Sigil
sc: Dark Phoenix Knight Blade is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 Dark Phoenix Sigils from the Dark Phoenix Armoury.
Dark Romancer Attire (Bone White) is a cosmetic override outfit that can be unlocked through the Gifts from the Heart promotion from Treasure Hunter.
Desert sole is a food that can be obtained by cooking raw desert sole at level 52 in Cooking, which can be caught in the Port district of Menaphos.
Dioscuri Sword Off-Hand is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 40 of Zodiyak Track with the premier pass.
It can be created from 3,600 divination fragments with level 80 Divination and 20 Invention.
It could also be obtained from Treasure Hunter between 14 and 16 November 2015.
However, with the release of The Tourist Trap quest, their popularity dropped as the desert robes released with the quest were identical in appearance and are easier to obtain.
The dwarf fragment is an item obtained during the Birthright of the Dwarves quest.
The emergency flask of stew is an item found in Evil Dave's bank during the Evil Dave's Big Day Out quest.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
It is unlocked by activating an unused Erethdor's grimoire.
Exiled Guardian Staff is a two-handed magic weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 350 Underworld Emblems from the Hero Store.
It is made by adding a red topaz to an exquisite cooking urn (no gem).

The Fayre Mallet is a two-hand melee weapon cosmetic override reward unlocked by consuming a mallet token, which can be purchased from Rixie during the Spring Fayre for 900 Fayre prize tickets, or rarely found while participating in activities during the Fayre.
It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 130 spirit shards, a green charm, and a banana in the backpack, requiring 69 Summoning and giving 121.
It can be made into ten Fruit Bat scrolls (Fruitfall) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 1.

h: Path of the Creators - Part II
sc: Ful Templar's Halberd is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override unlocked by completing tier 47 of the Path of the Creators - Part II Yak Track with the premier pass.
Giftwrapped Guard is a main hand necromancy weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by redeeming a Giftwrapped Guard (Untradeable) token.
To obtain a gilded cavalier, the player can either trade with another player or receive one as a master-level Treasure Trails reward.
It is given to the player by Golrie as a reward for freeing him from the Gnome Village Dungeon.
If players lose this pebble, they can go back to Golrie to obtain another.
It can also be re-obtained at May's Quest Caravan after putting 150 quest points into the Hub Track.
The goebie disguise kit is obtained by using the magic flute on Lunch four times until he gives you the kit, as part of the Mod Deg trading sequence.

r: Partial completion of Priest in Peril
Partial completion of Priest in Peril
sc: It is found while searching the monuments in the temple's dungeon for an iron key.
It is obtained by using an unlit normal candle on the north-west monument (black candles do not work).
It is obtained by using a tooth extractor with mango with tooth.
Grotesque (Tier 1) Cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 200 credits from the Trader's Store or for 1,500 Double XP Tokens from the DXP Token Store.
A yellow hat can be purchased from Barker at his store Barker's Haberdashery in Canifis.

s: Burthorpe; can be accessed via Amascut Sigil
Burthorpe; can be accessed via Showdown Sigil
sc: Herald of Amascut Gauntlets is a cosmetic override outfit that is unlocked through the Desert Showdown promotion from Treasure Hunter.
It can be purchased with 2 Amascut Sigils.
High Armour of Hanto handguards is a tier 70 hybrid armour that can be bought from Waiko Reward Shop for 7,500 chimes and 10 taijitu.
The Kangali Bunny appearance token is a token unlock item that can be randomly obtained by redeeming a Skill Pet Bunny appearance token or by opening a mystery egg.
A kethsian key is an item obtained during the Grandmaster quest, Ritual of the Mahjarrat.

tx:
▸ Pruning chance
Leaves can be obtained from Farming by pruning any diseased bush, fruit tree, calquat tree, spirit tree, or elder tree (other wood trees use the same chances but give their own leaves). Each prune action will attempt a skilling success chance roll based on your Farming level to successfully prune some leaves (it does not vary by plant). If this is successful, there is a second roll which has a 1/4 chance to give the message and you will have to click the plant again; and a 3/4 chance to recieve some leaves and cure the plant with the message
sc: Leaves are obtained when using any secateurs to cure any bush or fruit tree of disease or by using the Remote Farm spell to cure a plant.
They can also be dropped by baby tanglefootii in the Shady grove near the Cosmic altar after A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains.
A left eyepatch is a lootable item from Pirate implings, which can be caught after the Rocking Out quest.
A pirate hat and eyepatch can also be made by having Patchy sew a left eyepatch and a pirate's hat together.

tx: Players may obtain the following rewards from these lucky charms:
sc: They can be purchased from the Daemonheim Rewards shop for 15,000 Dungeoneering tokens each.
The Lucky Zamorak godsword (passive) is created by using a Lucky Zamorak godsword on the altar in K'ril Tsutsaroth's room.
Lunar staff - pt1 is made by using a dramen staff on the Air altar during the Lunar Diplomacy quest.
After the quest is complete lunar staves can no longer be made through this process.
It can be re-obtained at May's Quest Caravan after putting 150 quest points into the Hub Track.
To obtain one, the player must have completed the quest The Feud and the blackjack section of the Rogue Trader merchandise.

Medium glitter bomb.x: A medium glitter bomb is a Treasure Hunter reward. The chosen skill receives 130% of the bonus experience that a medium prismatic fallen star would yield, and the other skills 5% of the star's bonus experience.

sc: A medium XP lamp (Dungeoneering) is a fairly common prize from Treasure Hunter.
Mime gloves are clothing items which can be bought from Iffie for 500 coins.
Formerly, it was a reward for completing the Mime random event.

Nex (Attuned) Boots.x: The Nex (Attuned) Boots are a feet slot cosmetic override that is part of the Nex (Attuned) set. They are the upgraded version of the Nex Boots, unlocked after killing Nex 5 times with the full unattuned Nex outfit equipped.

sc: Orikalkum crossbow (unstrung) is an unfinished crossbow which can be created at level 63 Fletching by joining a mahogany stock with orikalkum limbs, granting 87 Fletching experience.
Paraleather coif is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
The pendant of Hunting is a pendant of skill that may be obtained as a prize from the Squeal of Fortune.

s: Burthorpe; can be accessed via Pestilent Gem shard
sc: It can be purchased for 3 Pestilent Gem shards from the Pestilent Torva Trove shop.
The pink Santa hat is a head slot item that can be obtained from any Christmas present during the 2024 Christmas event, and certain Christmas presents from the 2025 Christmas event onward.
In 2024, it was guaranteed to be obtained from a Gold Christmas Present.
A plague doctor rest override token is an unlock token that can be won on Treasure Hunter during the Contagion promotion.
It can be claimed to unlock the Plague Doctor Register Wagon Rest override, destroying the token in the process.
Pneumatic gloves are melee gloves dropped by Automaton Tracers that can be found in the Guthixian temple after completing The World Wakes.

sc: Prime colossus is a legendary pet that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked through Prime Gaming between 11 April 2017 to 8 May 2017.
It is obtained by popping one of the Balloon Animals.
Project Blackfire can be obtained when excavating at various excavation hotspots at the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site.
A protea flower is an equipable hunter-related item obtained from Big Chinchompa.
It can be bought from Party Pete's Emporium in the Party Room for 50 coins.

Radiant Dawn Gauntlets.x: The Radiant Dawn Gauntlets are a hands slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by claiming the RuneScape Mobile founders pack.

Replica Barrows (Dharok) Platebody.x: The Replica Barrows (Dharok) Platebody is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Replica Barrows (Dharok) outfit.

sc: Roast potatoes could be obtained from opening a festive cracker.
They were reintroduced as a reward from Christmas cracker crate in 2018, but this time they did not heal despite the tooltip claiming that they would.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 8 rune bars and a rune square shield + 2, requiring 1,440 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,920 Smithing experience.
The player must obtain four different notes for the quest by killing Skeletons, Dried zombies and Scabarites north of the archaeologist camp, or Mummies to the west.
Seiryu's claw is an item dropped by arhat found on Aminishi through the Well of Spirits, at a rate of 1 in 1024.
There is also a rare chance for any of the monsters found in the Temple of Aminishi to drop this item.

tx: Receiving Crafting experience from using a shade skull on a staff incurs a five-minute cooldown during which no more Crafting experience may be gained from doing so.

sc: The shard of the Blade is a relic component that can be claimed from the shattered blade found on a table in the entrance room of the Guthixian ruins after partial completion of The World Wakes.
A small XP lamp (Attack) is a common prize from Treasure Hunter.
The spicy pepper wrap is a food item that can be made by combining a plain wrap and spicy pepper sauce, or by obtaining it from an event.
It was available from the Squeal of Fortune between 5 May and 13 May 2013.

tx: Stardust can be exchanged for rewards from the Shooting Star Reward Shop which is accessed by talking to Wizard Rosalina on the of the Wizards' Tower.
sc: Stardust is an item that can be mined from crashed stars during Shooting Star, a Distractions and Diversions activity.
The amount of stardust mined can be increased with the use of the Honed perk from Invention and with the Shooting Star buff received from a star sprite.

r: Completion of The Void Stares Back

sc: The team-18 cape is a wilderness cape that can be purchased for 50 coins from Edmond.
The Thorobshuun key can be found when mining tin, copper, or necrite rocks in the Warforge south tunnel mine, within the Warforge Dig Site.

sc: A tile is currently a useless item that can be found in certain places in the Wilderness.

Tithe Collector's Robe Bottom.x: The Tithe Collector's Robe Bottom is a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Tithe Collector's Pack.

h: First time becoming available to Ironman Mode players.
sc: Tomb gorilla is a pet unlocked by redeeming a tomb gorilla pet token.
The Totem of Intimidation top can be found on Anachronia by searching the rubble north of the larger of the two ruins on the north-east portion of the island.
A trail-be-gone is an item that was formerly obtained and used in the Wilderness.
The Broav was also not added in the initial release of Summoning, but was later added as a reward from While Guthix Sleeps while truffles were not.
A pig familiar that hunted truffles was a reward considered for the Bringing Home the Bacon quest, however this dropped due to lack of a use for the truffles obtained.
On 2 September 2008 the truffle's price somehow increased by 10 coins, bringing the market price up to 210 coins, despite it being impossible to obtain and trade the item.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.

Warrior of Het armour.x: The Warrior of Het armour is a cosmetic override outfit that is unlocked from the Oasis Restoration event. As of 31 January 2022, it can also be obtained randomly while skilling in Het's Oasis.

sc: The Wilderness manual is a book found by searching bookcases around Gielinor, such as the one in the of Varrock Palace, in the southern part and in the house north of the Varrock estate agent.

q: Winter Hat and Winter Scarf (green and red)
sc: The green and red Winter Hat (referred to as Winter hat 6 in the tooltip) is a head slot item that can be obtained during the 2023 Christmas event by completing the It's Snow Bother quest.
It can be obtained by opening a medium reward casket that can be found during the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion.
Zygomite fruit is an item obtained by gathering produce from a zygomite at the player-owned farm.
